originalAssertionUnchanged: A subject whose read disposition on a field is transformed or withheld cannot mutate that field: evaluateSecurityWrite and the write routine refuse without an original read disposition or declared blind-write permission, including a proposed value equal to the mask output; absent column UPDATE privilege is a direct-SQL negative control; RETURNING old/new never discloses the pre-image of a masked or withheld column; failed checks leave no effects.

findings.correction: Check Field/read-or-blind permission for every explicit native assignment intent before hidden equality; preserve and separately report existing logical no-op semantics.
Select RC/read-write explicitly and acquire authority exclusion before fresh observation; do not infer freshness from SHARE alone.
Besides absent-UPDATE control, isolate read privilege with temporary UPDATE-only grant and positive constant write, then old/new RETURNING42501 and exact restoration.
